sentences.en: He is always dwelling on the pleasures of the past.
sentences.zh: 他总是沉浸在过去的快乐中。

sentences.en: What dwells in the mind is seen in the dream.
sentences.zh: 梦里映现的是心中所想。

sentences.en: For Sami, not dwelling on the past was a struggle.
sentences.zh: 对于萨米来说，不去纠结过去是一大挑战。

senses.zh: 居住，栖身；总是想着，唠叨（dwell on）
